name: break

The frame numbers below are what the sheets actually came back with, which is measured rather than assumed — see the -report flag on cmd/spindle-moves, and the loop join it prints.

moves.name: bounce
moves.//: The one he does standing, and the one he comes back to between the others. All of it is the loop: there is nothing to go into and nothing to come out of.
